remarks: Welcome to 34 Brown Avenue, also known as 18 Brown Avenue-a townhouse-style condominium offering comfort, convenience, and a fantastic location. This well-laid-out unit features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, and a partially finished basement that provides added flexibility for storage, recreation, or work-from-home space. Ideally situated within walking distance to vibrant downtown Stamford, you'll enjoy easy access to a wide array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options-everything you need just steps from your front door. Whether you're a first-time buyer or an investor seeking a conveniently located property, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss. Listed while occupied, no showings allowed. Offered strictly "as-is", this property is subject to no contingencies or inspections. The buyer will be responsible for obtaining possession of the property upon closing. No interior photos available.
